coaching.headline: A 40-minute win we nearly handed back: the river ran 10 buffs to 26, five Fangtooth-line spawns went to them, and it took the 38-minute Orb Prime to end it.
coaching.team: Our pre-game read had mid and offlane favored, and both started that way. But the neutral map was conceded from the first spawn: the 9-minute Fangtooth fell uncontested with all five of us alive, and Genesis Core and Orb Prime both went the same uncontested way at 30. The middle of the game was fought short-handed by choice. The fight at 14 was lost 0-2 with Phase alive and not joining and Gideon alive and ahead. The fight at their Fangtooth at 22.9 was lost 0-4 with Shinbi alive and ahead across the map. The worst was at 28.4: a 5v4 on the scoreboard that was three of ours against two on the ground, lost 0-3, with Primal Fangtooth falling at 29. Even the fight at 37.1 went 2-2 with a 5v2 advantage. Two clean wins at their inner tower, 4-2 at 24.4 and 3-1 at 27.3, were left uncashed. What saved it: Sparrow and Khaimera won 3-0 at their river at 36.2, a fight taken a body down after Shinbi was caught at 35.5. The team cashed that win into Genesis Core at 37 and Orb Prime at 38. The fight at our outer tower at 38.9, won 4-0, closed the game. Next game: man-up fights get all five bodies — a numbers edge that never arrives at the fight is how Primal Fangtooth walked away at 29.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: What turned a conceded map into a win? The sequence from 35.5 to 38.9. Shinbi getting caught by Mourn at 35.5 should have been the throw. Instead Sparrow and Khaimera won the next fight at their river 3-0, a body down. The team cashed it into Genesis Core at 37 and Orb Prime at 38. The fight at our outer tower, won 4-0, ended it. Every earlier stretch had fight wins without the cash, with the wins at 24.4 and 27.3 both going uncashed. This one finally had both.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's raw support output was real, 32,801 healing and 15 wards. But Phase was alive and joined none of five fights. Two came early, at 14 and 19.2. Two more came late, at 34.3 and 36.2. The fifth was the man-up fight at their Primal Fangtooth at 28.4. The fight next door needed the peel more than any lane needed the healing.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 won the favored mid early, built the complete 57.6% Azure Core, Combustion and Wraith Leggings core, and led our side in hero damage with 52,680. The gaps: the solo catch by The Fey at 17.5 came just before the outer tower fell at 17.9. And Gideon was alive but joined neither the man-up fight at their Primal at 28.4 nor the body-down win at their river at 36.2.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster went 12/5/4 into a carry matchup that read theirs all game, and the two fights that won it were Sparrow's: the win at their river at 36.2, 3-0 while a body down, and the close at 38.9, won 4-0. The build skipped the entire 56.2% Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter and Spectra core — the closing power arriving late is part of why the game did too.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim held the only offlane read that stayed ours all game, but the deaths were expensive. The death at 20 came just before the inner tower fell at 20.1. The outer followed at 21.3. The death at 30.4 was the worst one. Both inhibitors followed, the first at 31.4 and the second at 31.5. And the catch by Mourn at 35.5 made the fight at 36.2 start a body down. The lane was won, and those death timers gave most of it back.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Khaimera was the engine of the wins at 24.4 and 36.2, with 22,983 damage to objectives and 82,832 damage soaked. But there were nine deaths, and three of them came directly before a Fangtooth or Primal fell to the other side. Two wards in 40 minutes from the jungle left the river dark, and it ran 10 buffs to 26.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.text: Five fights with Phase alive and not joining, spread from 14 to 36.2. 32,801 healing cannot reach a fight it never attends.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.text: Top damage on our side, 52,680, on the one fully built winning core at 57.6%, from a mid that held its favored read early — the foundation the comeback stood on.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.text: Twelve kills in a matchup that read losing on paper, plus both closing fights: the win at 36.2 while a body down and the close at 38.9, won 4-0. Sparrow finished what the rest could not.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.text: One death at 30.4, and both inhibitors fell right after it. In the offlane, what those deaths gave away mattered more than the 5/5/5.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.text: Nine deaths with three Fangtooth-line objectives falling right after them, plus 2 wards in 40 minutes — the jungle fought everything and controlled nothing on the river, which ran 10 buffs to 26.

coaching.whatWorked: The final sequence is the model. A fight at their river was won even a body down and cashed immediately into Genesis Core at 37 and Orb Prime at 38. Then came the close off our own outer tower at 38.9 — fight, cash, finish, with no wandering between. Three minutes of that discipline did what the half-hour before it could not.

38.9.call: Everything the earlier fights were missing arrived at once: an engage accepted on our own ground with Orb Prime already taken at 38, and the win walked straight into the close. Nothing to correct — this setup was available at every spawn before it.

22.9.call: A Fangtooth contest only works with all five: either the fifth body is called in before it starts, or the spawn is conceded and the map is taken elsewhere. Walking in four-strong bought the worst of both, losing the fight and the objective.

24.4.call: What was the plan for the seconds after the fight was won? Their timers were the window to take the tower or leave. Instead the fight at their inner tower at 24.4, won 4-2, gave back Khaimera at 24.7. Sparrow followed at 25, and our own inner tower fell at 25.4 — a clean win never cashed.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Mr_Meat31 turned Phase into a second carry: Prophecy and Spectra for on-hit damage, Plasma Blade's crit ramp, Sky Splitter's current-health shred. The entire support core went unbought, and it is worth naming what that surrenders: Enra's Blessing auto-shields an ally the instant they get locked down, and Galaxy Greaves bring both resists, which the facts flag, no armor against a three-physical lineup that put 47,935 damage into her. Tainted Totem still carried the anti-heal job against Mourn's 19,115 health healed, and the link still delivered 32,801 health to allies; the experiment added 21,166 hero damage and removed the safety net.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Vesh backs the aggressive read on Phase: her damaging abilities leave a burn, Mind Rot makes it count on durable targets like Crunch, and The Tenth Seal boosts the level-10 ultimate. On a damage-built Phase the fit is tighter than usual, since the build and the blessing both bet on her hurting people. The trade-off is the same bet twice: nothing here improves her heals or shields, so the carry's protection rests entirely on her link and her positioning.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Goldilocks324 had Gideon's full core: Azure Core's mana stacking and shield, Combustion's area burst, Wraith Leggings' penetration, then Oblivion Crown multiplying total magic power. Lifecore was the interesting fifth: its wisps convert his damage into heals for the lowest-health ally nearby, a team-medic layer on a burst mage. Against the enemy Fey's 85k magical, the game's biggest output, his 52,680 hero damage held the mirror of the mid lane close enough for the win; the absent consideration was magic resist, with only 1 of 5 of us buying any into that 85k.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vesh belongs on Gideon: his area casts hit several enemies at once, and each hit plants a burn that scales as the game lengthens. The Tenth Seal feeds the level-10 ultimate his best fights are built around, and Mind Rot bites into Crunch and Mourn. What it costs is any answer to being dived; the pre-game read had his kill threat peaking early against The Fey, and this loadout is built to press that threat from range, offering nothing once someone jumps him.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Cuban Noobster took Sparrow down the crit road, Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher, Imperator, and Demolisher, instead of her listed attack-speed core of Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter, and Spectra, which wins through sheer volume of on-hit procs. The crit version pays in bigger single arrows plus Demolisher's armor piercing, and 12 kills on 42,018 hero damage settles the argument for this game. Tainted Rounds in the third slot was the sharpest buy of all: its healing cut, strongest against wounded targets, faced a lineup where Scarlett healed 20,239 health, Mourn 19,115, and Crunch 15,856.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Vermis and Sparrow's rhythm are the same idea: uninterrupted arrows on one target, with every third one adding max-health damage that no armor build fully answers, especially with Melting Point stacked on. Serration adds the finishing edge her execute item echoes. It trades away mobility and safety entirely, so it depends on her team holding a frontline, which Shinbi and Khaimera spent this game doing.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Willy Guggenheim hit Shinbi's core, with Orb Of Growth evolved into Enlightenment for stacking stats, Tainted Scepter's healing cut pointed at a Crunch who healed 15,856 health, and Oathkeeper's empowered strike after every cast. Magnify's magic-armor shred and World Breaker's tenacity rounded it into a caster-bruiser. The flag is the familiar one: no armor into a three-physical lineup, and 69,058 damage taken was the second-heaviest load on the team; one armor-and-health buy would have made all that frontlining cheaper.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vesh runs on Shinbi's casts: her wolves and dashes are ability damage, each application leaves a burn, and Mind Rot keeps it relevant against a bruiser like Crunch who stacks health. The Tenth Seal boosts her level-10 ultimate for the teamfights this game kept producing. The trade is toughness, none is included, which the no-armor flag in her build made doubly true; the loadout wants her darting through fights, not standing in them.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Xeebs built Khaimera to wade in and stay: Overlord's permanent health stacking, Draconum's healing amplification, Void Helm boosting all healing received by a hero whose kit heals on every swing, plus Aegis Of Agawar's armor swell. The 17,235 health healed and 82,832 damage taken say the sponge worked; what got skipped was the damage half, Rapture's on-hit sting and Basilisk's stacking armor shred, which is part of why nine deaths came with 20,676 hero damage to show for all that pressure. Against an enemy Scarlett who healed 20,239 herself, an anti-heal piece was the other missing tool in a mirror of sustain brawlers.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vermis is close to a description of Khaimera: he already wins by staying attached and swinging, and the every-third-hit max-health damage makes those swings dangerous to the tanks his axes otherwise struggle to dent. Melting Point widens that anti-armor edge and Serration closes out low targets. The trade-off is that it adds no reach and no toughness, and with nine deaths this game that cost was live; the blessing rewards exactly the extended contact that got him focused.

synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

fedBy: Tithe of Death (minor): Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.
lines: Lead story: Healed through fights. 145 healing a minute, more than 98% of Gideon mid players this patch.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Gideon touched shortened Black Hole, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 66s late); fight right after Black Hole is spent.
Black Hole at rank 3: 105s base, about 66s by the end (37% shorter) from 59 ability haste: Azure Core 10, Lifecore 15, Epoch 8, Tithe of Death (minor) 26.
Tithe of Death (minor): 2 per takedown, 13 takedowns.
13 takedowns (4 kills, 9 assists) fed: Tithe of Death (minor).
Gideon dealt 52,680 hero damage, 31% of their team's, with +490 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11; against Scarlett (level 18: about 62 magical armor, 42 after penetration; took 18,640 magical damage from heroes, 66% of all hero damage they took) and Mourn (level 18: about 97 magical armor, 77 after penetration; took 19,664 magical damage from heroes, 49% of all hero damage they took) that is about 14% and 11% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Lifecore (item): Upon damaging Heroes: Gain charges equal to 15% of damage dealt. At 100 charges, damage a Hero to trigger Healing Wisp.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 23% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.

Sustain: 12% heal and shield power; Azure Core: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 100 (+12%) Shield for 5s.; Lifecore: Upon damaging Heroes: Gain charges equal to 15% of damage dealt. At 100 charges, damage a Hero to trigger Healing Wisp.; Lifecore: Fire a healing wisp at the Lowest Health Allied Hero within a 1000u radius. Heals for 100 (+40%).; 5,806 healing recorded.

Loadout augment Infinite Impact: Void Breach flies across the map, so you can snipe low targets or poke from very far away. Great for finishing fleeing enemies. (game text: Void Breach has infinite range.) (changes Void Breach, 5.7s cooldown with their haste) Field: 48.1% in 7401 games, 60% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.3%.

Loadout Eternal Vesh: Every ability hit leaves a short burn. Void Breach, Cosmic Rift and Black Hole all add extra damage after they land. (game text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.) [7% growing 0.4% a minute: about 23% by the end (40 min)] Field: 49% in 8634 games, 70% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.3%.

Loadout minor Tithe of Death: Takedowns refund mana and permanently shorten your ability cooldowns, up to a cap. Snowballs Gideon's spell rotation as the fights go your way. (game text: Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.) Field: 48.7% in 5017 games, 58% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.3%.

Loadout minor Phylactery: After Black Hole, your cooldowns tick twice as fast for 4s and you get a shield based on your max mana, so Void Breach and Cosmic Rift come back sooner. (game text: After your Ultimate, gain 100% Cooldown Progression for 4s and a shield equal to 15% of Max Mana for 4s. 20s cooldown.) Field: 48.6% in 5827 games, 67% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.3%.

Loadout crest Epoch: Freeze yourself in place, safe from damage. Use it if you get dived while channeling or after Black Hole lets you act, then teleport away with Torn Space. (game text: Stasis Device:  Enter Stasis for 2.5s.) Field: 44.7% in 1726 games, 14% of picks, below the hero-role's 48.3%.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Vesh. Gideon has 3 damaging abilities (Void Breach, Cosmic Rift, Black Hole hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 59 ability haste brought them back 37% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Lifecore, Phylactery. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Wraith Leggings. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.

The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Phylactery) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; kept alive in fights), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.
Countered? 2 of the 3 players Gideon killed built magical armor (Mourn, Crunch). Anti-heal on The Fey, Scarlett. We killed Gideon 5 times.

Copy it? Vesh (Tithe of Death + Phylactery): 48.5% in 4,524 Gideon midlane games, level with the hero's 48.3%; this 3-item core: 52.5% in 2,815 games, level with the 52.4% of that hero-role's cores. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

card.lesson: Gideon's takedowns fed Black Hole: every kill or assist made it come back sooner. Deny early takedowns and fight right after Black Hole is used.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Phylactery) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; kept alive in fights), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.

countered.text: 2 of the 3 players Gideon killed built magical armor (Mourn, Crunch).

copy.text: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Phylactery): 48.5% in 4,524 Gideon midlane games, level with the hero's 48.3%; this 3-item core: 52.5% in 2,815 games, level with the 52.4% of that hero-role's cores. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.
